agent_profiles.name: counterexample_first
agent_profiles.instruction: Prefer the verdict that survives the strongest counterargument from the other side's perspective.

agent_profiles.name: surface_match
agent_profiles.instruction: Favor the verdict most directly supported by what the author actually did, without adding outside assumptions.

agent_profiles.name: plausibility_first
agent_profiles.instruction: Prefer the verdict that best matches how an ordinary, fair-minded community would judge the situation.
